tool_args.rationale: The observations span short and long horizons and show the predicted reversal. Fit all five parameters numerically to the guided sink-coupled dual-horizon law, then use fresh confirmation to test its forecast accuracy.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired probe already supplies three long-horizon observations in addition to the five pilot rows, supporting numerical estimation of the five guided parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Single-horizon Ricker or harmonic oscillation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed long-horizon reversal and the verified sink-coupled adaptation guidance favor the dual-horizon mechanism.
It is irrelevant to identification of the target law.
